chunks: Say: 'Of no gain will be your running away if you run from death or being killed, even then you will enjoy the good things of life but only for a while.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the futility of fleeing from death?
ai.summary: Revealed during the Battle of Uhud, this verse specifically targets the hypocrites (Munafiqun) who fled the battlefield, emphasizing that their escape was not a divine pardon but merely a delay of inevitable judgment. Shia exegetes highlight the brevity of their 'enjoyment' as a sign of spiritual emptiness, contrasting their cowardice with the steadfastness of the faithful who accept death as a natural decree.
